subject: Renewal: MedNova expansion — EU residency + APAC warm-standby and failover
messages:
From: Simon Park <simon.park@mednova.health>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-10T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion + EU residency & APAC standby

Hi Priya,

We're coming up to our renewal for MedNova's production plan (Oct 1). Usage has grown ~2.7x this year and the product team wants two things included in the renewal scope:

- EU data residency (primary processing in EU nodes only — Frankfurt/Dublin) for PHI-adjacent metadata
- APAC warm-standby (standby capacity in APAC region to handle regional surges, cross-region failover test on demand)

We'd like pricing and a high-level runbook for failover, plus any term changes if adding dedicated standby capacity. Can we get a proposal + suggested timeline?

We currently average 120 QPS (tokenized workload) during peak and have a burst profile up to 400 QPS for short windows.

Thanks — I can loop in contracts once we have a proposal.

—Simon
Head of Platform, MedNova Health

- APAC warm-standby: is this strictly for traffic surge protection or do you want session-level warm standby (KV cache warmed)?
- Expected committed increase: are you targeting a 2x or 3x committed token uplift for the 24-month renewal?

I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Wed; I want to bring pricing + SOW draft + runbook (ops play) to the call. Attaching a quick intake worksheet in the next message.

Subject: Internal: MedNova renewal — draft commercial + technical asks

Team — looping you in for pricing and legal ops. Summary of the ask (from Simon):

- Move MedNova from a 12-month to a 24-month term with an uplift in committed units to cover anticipated peak growth. Customer prefers predictable pricing for 24 months.
- Primary data processing: EU-only (Frankfurt/Dublin). No US processing for content derived from PHI-adjacent workloads.
- Add APAC warm-standby (warm nodes, KV warming during scheduled windows) with an automated failover option and runbook. SLO target: 99.95% availability cross-region failover readiness; RTO for failover tests = 30 minutes.
- Pricing: they expect a blended uplift rather than linear token pricing (they asked for a 20–35% uplift estimate).

Requests:
- Ben: can you put together a 24-month pricing sheet (3 options: modest uplift + APAC standby as add-on; mid upgrade with dedicated warm-standby included; aggressive committed uplift with discount) — include committed GPU SKU counts for Dedicated add-on.
- Soojin: feed in the failover runbook / ops checklist and confirm what we can promise for RTO/RPO for a warm-standby flows.
- Naomi (privacy): quick review on EU-only enforcement (region pinning + encryption/KMS notes).

HubSpot deal: HUB-78941 — goal is to lock terms before 2028-08-24 to hit Oct 1 start date.

I'll host a customer sync once we have the initial commercial.

Thanks,
Priya
